sloka: अप्रियस्य तु पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः ।बद्धम् कालस्य पाशेन सर्व भूत अपहारिणा ॥६-१६-२२॥।।
transliteration: apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktā śrotā ca durlabhaḥ ।baddham kālasya pāśena sarva bhūta apahāriṇā ॥6-16-22॥।।

translations.english: "Bound by the noose of death which is the cause of destruction of all beings you are going to be killed just as the burning house if you ignore my advice."
